'''C'rel''' was the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[N'zoth system/Legends|N'zoth system]], located in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]] on the edge of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by eight [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] and was the home [[Star system/Legends|system]] of the [[Yevetha]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />
